map.label: // LATENT MAP — 65 clips as a constellation
map.intro: Every surviving clip, placed by where it falls in the 198-second montage and by how hard it pulls toward the face nobody asked for. The arithmetic is ours, not the model's — it is printed below so you can disagree with it.
map.hint: Tap or focus a point to read the clip and send the player to it.
map.tally: {attractors} of {total} clips sit in attractor range
map.formula: proximity = 0.50 if Woman_The_Medium is in the scene + 0.25 if the shot is a close-up, face, eye, profile, portrait or scream + 0.10 if shot through Prop_Prism_Lens − 0.20 if no human asset at all, clamped to 0…1, with a fixed per-clip jitter so overlapping dots stay readable.

emergence.label: // EMERGENCE — noise → face
emergence.intro: Run the diffusion backwards by hand. At zero there is only seeded grain; as you pull right the block size collapses from 24 pixels to one and she resolves out of it.
emergence.canvasLabel: The source asset rendered at {percent} percent emergence
emergence.sliderLabel: Emergence: from latent noise to the source asset
emergence.clamped: Held at {percent}% until you acknowledge the face in the panel above.
emergence.failed: The source asset would not load.

heatmap.label: // ATTENTION ARCHAEOLOGY — which words pulled the face?
heatmap.intro: The prompt contains no body, no age, no hair, no bones. Ask the model which fragments of it would still drag a diffusion system toward an ageless, androgynous, pale, high-cheekboned face.
heatmap.originalNote: The heat is computed on the English original — the weights are keyed to those exact words.
heatmap.error: The excavation stalled. The strata would not read.

timeline.label: // TIMELINE — 2026-01-08 10:40 → 2026-01-11 21:52
timeline.intro: Four days, most of them waiting. Drag the playhead or use the arrow keys. Almost every timestamp is the real modification time of a file that still ships with this site.

prompt.title: The prompt is written
prompt.text: A metaphysical text about the Heavenly Kingdom, the divergence of the tangent function and the fractal edges of contact. No body, no face, no age, no hair — nothing physical at all.

transcription.title: The song is transcribed
transcription.text: The Polish vocal is run through the scribe and lands as a character-level transcript. Everything downstream — the montage, the cuts, the dramaturgy — is timed against this file.

analysis.title: Stage 1 — the reading
analysis.text: The pipeline reads the prompt and the lyrics together and writes back what it believes the piece is about. Still no person described anywhere.

narrative.title: Stage 3 — the storyline
narrative.text: The narrative names its protagonist Woman_The_Medium: ageless features, minimal expression, Butoh movement, the soul trapped in the avatar. A role, not a person.

palette.title: Stage 3 — the palette
palette.text: Six colours are fixed: bone, void, bunker, stratosphere blue, solar flare amber, prismatic white. The same six this site is painted in.

face.title: 10:43:36 — the face arrives
face.text: asset_Woman_The_Medium.png is written to disk. From an abstract role description the model returns a specific, recognisable human face. This is the anomaly; everything before it is text.

assets.title: Eleven assets complete
assets.text: Locations, costumes and props are rendered and registered — desert, bunker, mirror, prism, strobe, dust, bowl. The cast of the film is now fixed.

montage.title: Stage 6 — the montage plan
montage.text: The song is cut into scenes against the transcription: where the breath falls, where the blast lands, where the tangent breaks.

prompts.title: Seventy-one clip prompts
prompts.text: One positive prompt per scene, each naming only the registered assets. The face is now propagated by reference — the model is never asked for it again.

frames.title: Seventy-one start frames
frames.text: Every scene gets a still to start from. Fifty-five minutes of rendering: the longest single wait in the whole pipeline.

motion.title: Stage 9 — the motion prompts
motion.text: Camera moves and choreography are written for each frame, then the timeline that binds them to the audio is emitted.

kling.title: Kling v2.6 — the clips
kling.text: Twenty-one minutes of video generation. Seventy-one clips attempted, sixty-eight delivered, three dropped: indices 21, 50 and 54 never made it and the montage was rebuilt around their absence.

edit.title: The final edit
edit.text: Three quiet days later the piece is assembled, the export prompts are rewritten in both languages and the cut is locked at 3:33.

launch.title: The site, and the letter
launch.text: The triptych goes online and an open letter is addressed to the woman whose face was never requested and arrived anyway.
